subject: Fix theme palette labels showing Japanese for non-Japanese UI cultures
body:
Fix theme palette labels showing Japanese for non-Japanese UI cultures

ColorKeyDisplayName() unconditionally looked up each palette color key
in ColorKeyJaMap and fell back to the raw key if missing - so every
non-Japanese user saw a mix of Japanese labels (for keys present in the
map) and raw underscored keys (for keys missing from it).

Gate the Japanese labels behind CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture being
"ja", and humanize the raw key (underscores -> spaces) for everyone
else. Japanese-culture users keep their original labels unchanged.

Also reword OptionsThemeChangeWarning now that theme changes apply
live (previous commit) - it no longer claims a restart is required,
just notes some DockPanel chrome may not update until restart.

triage.rationale: The Japanese theme translation map and display method do not exist in our fork, so the leak bug cannot occur.
